title: West Bengal SIR: Supreme Court says excluded 75-year-old lawyer ought to be included in voter list
description: The Supreme Court on Friday orally observed that a 75-year-old advocate who was excluded from the final voter list in West Bengal after the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls appeared to be entitled for inclusion in the list.
